# Synthetic composition fixtures

All records are synthetic; none prove a live source or device connection. Records
are extracted/projected arrays, not guaranteed whole MCP response envelopes.
Forward and Infrahub use the explicitly normalized export contract, not an invented
vendor response schema. CML/EVE-NG/GNS3 include separately evidenced synthetic
management enrichment; remove it to exercise console-only refusal. Tests set an
